items.headline: MiniMax releases Hailuo 2.3 video model
items.summary: Hailuo 2.3 and Hailuo 2.3 Fast update the Hailuo 02 video model with better body movement, facial micro-expressions, stylization and response to motion instructions. They are available on the Hailuo app, web and API, with the Fast version priced lower for batch generation.
